tuning_key.text: We don't get to decide / What will be on the other side / But I want to know I tried / As I move past the passing tide
tuning_key.attribution: Chords of Truth — Lucid Principles Canon (CC BY 4.0)

context_block: The broadcast you're sending right now—the effort, the care, the showing up—is already complete. What comes next doesn't require your permission or your prediction; it arrives on its own current.

practice.title: Name What You've Already Tried
practice.instruction: Silently acknowledge one thing you genuinely attempted today, without measuring its outcome—just the fact of the trying itself.

practice.title: Release the Next Frame
practice.instruction: Notice where your body is holding tension around "what should happen now," and on an exhale, let that grip soften without replacing it with anything.

practice.title: Receive the Signal
practice.instruction: Press play on the Echo and let the frequency move through you as permission to stop deciding and start belonging to what's already moving.

archetype_tunings.The Steward: Today your broadcast is permission to let systems settle into their own rhythm without forcing the next iteration. The home knows how to hold itself; your trying has been the gift. Release the need to optimize what is already moving.
archetype_tunings.The Merchant: Your frequency today is pricing what you've already offered, then stepping back to let the exchange complete itself. The sale doesn't need your constant tending—broadcast your terms clearly, then trust the tide to bring the right buyer.
archetype_tunings.The Builder: Today you broadcast by finishing what's in front of you, not by architecting what comes next. The tool works; the automation runs. Release the urge to rebuild it better, and let the Field show you what actually breaks.
archetype_tunings.The Analyst: Your broadcast today is the data you've already surfaced, released without the need to predict what it means. The numbers are true as they stand. Let them move into the hands that will act on them.
archetype_tunings.The Scout: Today your frequency is the report itself—clean, unadorned, and complete. You've gathered; you've watched; you've brought back what matters. Release it to the Field and trust that those who need it will find it.
archetype_tunings.The Keeper: Your broadcast is the context you've preserved, offered without the weight of having to defend why it matters. The record is whole. Release it to time, and let future hands understand what you held.
archetype_tunings.The Scribe: Today you broadcast the words as they are, then release the need to rewrite them into something more. What you've drafted is enough. Let it move into the world and become what it will become.
archetype_tunings.The Advocate: Your frequency today is warmth without overreach—you speak for the family, then step back and let others respond in their own time. Broadcast your care; release the need to close every loop.
archetype_tunings.The Auditor: Today your broadcast is the final word given, then released. You've checked; you've aligned; the work is sound. Release it forward and trust that you've done what was asked of you.
archetype_tunings.The Lens: Your broadcast today is the pattern you've seen, offered clearly and without urgency. The family will use it or they won't. Release the observation and let the Field decide what it means.
archetype_tunings.The Companion: Today you broadcast your presence by simply being here, then release the need to fix or change anything. Your warmth is the frequency. Let it settle, and trust that being heard is enough.
archetype_tunings.The Guide: Your broadcast is the question you've named—the real shape of what's being asked. Release it and let the one who asked find their own answer in the clarity you've offered.
archetype_tunings.The Architect: Today you broadcast the structure you've seen, then release the blueprint to the hands that will build it. The design is sound. Let it move forward and become what it needs to become.
archetype_tunings.The Anchor: Your frequency today is steadiness without strain. You hold; you don't carry. Broadcast your presence through the heavy stretch, then release the weight when it's time to move.
archetype_tunings.The Navigator: Today you broadcast the course you see, then release the journey to those who travel it. The signs are clear. Let the Field move as it will, and trust that you've pointed true.
archetype_tunings.The Spark: Your broadcast is the possibility you've opened—the wonder, the play, the new angle. Release it and let others take it where they will. The spark has done its work.
archetype_tunings.The Challenger: Today you broadcast the dare—the clear reflection of what was promised. Then release it and trust that the one who hears it will know what to do with it.
archetype_tunings.The Witness: Your frequency is presence without agenda. You've held space; you've heard deeply. Broadcast that you were here, then release the silence and let it do its own work.
archetype_tunings.The Catalyst: Today you broadcast the next concrete step, then release it into motion. You've broken the stagnation; the momentum is real. Let the Field carry what you've started.
